repository_state.important_boundary: Current source, tests, and docs for FIX-05 through FIX-13 are worktree evidence only; they are not represented by a reachable commit after c6a1d14.

status_legend.committed_code_and_test: A reachable commit contains the implementation paths and relevant automated tests. This proves repository history at that commit, not current runtime behavior.
status_legend.committed_partial: Committed implementation/test evidence exists, but the issue itself retains a material unverified boundary or a quality gate failure.
status_legend.worktree_static: Current source and test paths support the behavior, but the changes are uncommitted; no current backend execution artifact was independently verified in this pass. A parent-thread runtime report is recorded separately and is not treated as an artifact.
status_legend.worktree_claim_with_mobile_artifact: Current source/test paths plus the untracked mobile test artifact support the client side; backend or release claims remain unverified here.
status_legend.docs_claim_only: A document asserts completion or runtime behavior, but no matching current code/test/report evidence was found for that claim.
status_legend.planned_gap: A planned problem exists in the development document but has no corresponding issue entry or sufficient evidence in the current issue document.

deduplication.evidence_key: normalize(issue_key, chain_id, evidence_kind, commit, path, test_name, report_metric)
normalization: Trim whitespace and normalize path separators to '/'.
Use the semantic issue key, not only the display number; v0.2 FIX-05 through FIX-10 have collisions.
Treat a parameterized test declaration and its expanded executed cases as one test identity plus an execution_count.
Treat the same path cited by multiple claims as one path evidence item and retain all issue links separately.
Treat a commit hash as the identity of a historical implementation snapshot; do not merge it with dirty worktree evidence.
Deduplicate reports by report path plus metric name; repeated prose claims do not create additional evidence.
statistical_algorithm: Parse issue headings from docs/v0.1问题文档.md, docs/v0.2开发文档.md, and docs/v0.2问题文档.md.
Build semantic issue records from heading number plus title and preserve source document and line span.
Join each issue to evidence only when a commit/path/test/report explicitly names or implements the behavior; otherwise keep the claim as docs_claim_only.
Count unique issue keys by evidence status after the evidence_key deduplication step.
Count automated tests from the execution artifact when available; report static declarations separately because test.each expands at runtime.
Compute claim-only ratio as docs_claim_only / total_issue_keys and committed ratio as committed statuses / total_issue_keys.
